limitations: This review did not execute the final qualification tests; root owns the fresh frozen-source run.
All file/catalog/native checks are cooperative endpoint observations; they provide no atomic snapshot, continuous currentness guarantee or checkpoint lease.

No universal format decoder validator exists in pinned datasets 987. Separate native profile custody rebind authenticates only two retained Intent/Security 384D serialized fragments, preserving null identities for unsupported lanes.

resolved_findings.finding: An earlier task checkpoint could change while a later task authenticated; only metadata closed the aggregate batch.
resolved_findings.resolution: All earlier files now close against canonical path, regular single-link type and complete stat witnesses after later task authentication and metadata checks. Native boundary control mutates the actual earlier file.

resolved_findings.finding: Long final checkpoint reads occurred after final signed-source and native-world observations.
resolved_findings.resolution: Producer closes signed source/admission/native owner and metadata after authentication, then closes all checkpoint witnesses. Cold loader authenticates before the closing source/native/catalog observations and then closes all checkpoint witnesses. Four actual boundary controls cover source/native changes in preparation and cold reopening.

resolved_findings.finding: Python dictionary equality could equate boolean observation fields with integer JSON fields after receipt rehashing.
resolved_findings.resolution: Both cold-loader authentication comparisons now compare canonical serialized JSON bytes. Three actual receipt controls replace true with 1, false with 0, and nlink 1 with true.

review_scope: Read-only source and test review of checkpoint byte authentication, versioned ready-root context integration and final closing fences. Native retained profile survey/rebinding is separate metadata evidence.
verified_properties: Default @1 retains its field set, metadata-only behavior and availability scope. Opt-in @2 requires exact per-task IR selections and explicit typed authentication. A consumer requiring authentication rejects downgrade.

Original checkpoint content is streamed with exact hash/size pins, 512 MiB per-file and conservative 1 GiB aggregate bounds. No JSON/tensor interpretation, ModelManager construction, training, inference or provider call occurs.

All native catalog resolution fields and false authority observations remain unchanged. Separate byte-witness true fields do not admit a decoder or claim ABI, token/span, inventory, reconstruction, quality or proof status.

Read descriptors are no-follow, read-only, nonblocking and close-on-exec; descriptor/path witnesses and all-file endpoints check inode, mode, nlink, size, mtime and ctime. ExitStack closes descriptors on refusal.
Runtime/launch guards and root-only readiness restrictions remain active; dependent source publication closure and model runtime admission remain separate pending gates.
